description: How each GET in Anchore's API stands against the target of importing everything Anchore holds about artifacts and running containers (req-anchore-coverage). A read the collector makes is 'landed' and needs no entry here. Every other read matches the first rule below whose pattern matches its path: 'excluded' with the reason, or 'planned'. A read no rule matches is 'planned'. Edit a rule only with the ruling or the build that changes it.

rules.reason: the API root; it names the service and holds no record
administration of Anchore: accounts, users and permissions (ruled out, and personal data)
registry settings hold credentials (ruled out)
administration and operation of Anchore, not a fact about an artifact or a running container
bulk file download (ruled out)
secret-search and retrieved-file results are secret material (ruled out)
staging of an upload in progress; the finished image or source is read under /images or /sources
export jobs and their files: operation of Anchore and bulk downloads (ruled out)
deprecated duplicate of /apps; to revisit if an instance serves only this family
the output of an operator-defined report, derived from records read elsewhere
download of the STIG profile database, a bulk file; an image's STIG results are /images/{image_digest}/stig
archive rules are administration of Anchore
a count or lookup derived from records the collector reads itself
the same document as its JSON form in another encoding
the vulnerability list the collector reads, in another format
lists the names of the types the collector asks for; it holds no record
lists the names of the types the collector asks for; it holds no record
the same record as its entry in the /images list
the same record as its entry in the list the collector reads
every file of every image: very large; how to land it is undecided
